column1: # The pinned Mojo's verdict on every fixture in the assets/ error folders,
# An error fixture is rejected by both compilers, so an exit code proves
# nothing. Agreement here is the VERDICT: the pin must reject what the four
# compile-error folders claim it rejects, and must compile-and-trap what
# runtime_error claims. Mojito's own message is never compared with the pin's —
# it carries no source location outside the parser, and the two wordings differ
# for most fixtures by design. tests/corpus_test.rs owns Mojito's side through
# each fixture's `# expect:` directive; this file owns the pin's side only.
# verdict:  compile-reject  the pin refused to compile it
#           trap            the pin compiled it and it failed at run time
#           runs            the pin compiled it and it exited 0
#           timeout         the pin did not finish inside 60s
# family:   agree           the verdict matches the folder, on the same defect
#                           handler-argument, ledgered) — the pin rejected it, but
#                           for a spelling the fixture never set out to test, so
#                           the defect it pins went unexamined. The names are
#           subset          the pin accepts it and Mojito is deliberately
#           divergence      the pin accepts it and Mojito should not reject it,
#           skip            not comparable under this oracle
# upstream: for compile-reject and trap, the pin's own first complaint, which
# the sweep re-checks so a re-pin's rewording or an earlier complaint shows up;
# for runs, a one-line note on what Mojito rejects instead.
# Lifting a mask moves a row to another family rather than closing it: the pin
# reports one complaint at a time.
